summary: Phase 17 ROUND 4 (Forge / BoE / Equipment-detail / Set bonuses) — full backend + frontend E2E verification. issues: At 1280px viewport, the right-side nav link 'FORGE' is visually truncated to 'FORG' on /forge and 'FO' on /adventurers/{id}/equipment (where the breadcrumb 'ORBUS // ADVENTURERS' is wider). action_items: (low priority) Fix AppHeader CSS overflow so the right-side 'FORGE'/'OFFICINA' nav link does not get visually clipped on 1280px when the breadcrumb is long. Consider adding `min-w-0` to the flex container, shrinking the breadcrumb on md, or using `flex-shrink-0` only on the right cluster.

critical_code_review_comments: Forge.jsx (207 lines): clean structure, proper testids on all interactive elements, server-authoritative confirm flows, useCallback for load(). Good pattern.

Inventory.jsx bound-badge and Vai-a-Officina link properly conditioned on r.is_bound and item_type (weapon/armor/accessory). Tooltip uses title attribute (acceptable; could be upgraded to shadcn Tooltip for richer UX).
AdventurerEquipment.jsx set-bonuses-panel correctly renders empty state via set-bonuses-empty when active_bonuses is empty; does not crash on empty equipmentDetail. Good defensive code.
Market.jsx 422 interception checks status===422 && detail==='market.bound_item_not_sellable' — exact sentinel match, no false positives.

Backend BoE guard at /app/backend/app/market/services.py:259-272 returns HTTPException(status_code=422, detail='market.bound_item_not_sellable') — sentinel is i18n-key-shaped (dotted) which is the correct cross-cutting contract.
Forge seeds (3 sets, 13 enchants, dragon_essence, 5 legendaries) are idempotent on lifespan boot (run_forge_migration). Migration is safe to re-run.
